item.description:
🇨🇦 🚨 CANADA: MARRIAGE BUREAU DATABASE ALLEGEDLY OFFERED FOR SALE

A threat actor on a dark web forum is advertising a 23 GB SQL database they claim was taken from Canada Marriage Bureau, an online matrimonial platform. The actor claims more than 15 million rows.

The actor claims the data includes:
* Email addresses and phone numbers
* Passwords and gender
* OTP codes and session cookies

Samples shared by the actor appear to contain app or API request headers and session data.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If authentic, live session cookies and OTP codes could enable account takeover without a password, and matrimonial profiles are a common target for romance and extortion scams. Users should change passwords, log out of all sessions and enable MFA where offered. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Canada #DataBreach #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence

item.description:
🇪🇸 🚨 SPAIN: ESCAPADARURAL ALLEGEDLY HIT BY 31.1 MILLION-RECORD USER DATABASE LEAK

A threat actor using the alias "Drubitan" claims on an underground forum to have obtained a user database of EscapadaRural[.]com, one of Spain's best-known rural tourism booking platforms, totaling 31.1 million records.

What we know so far:
* Claimed volume: 31.1 million user records
* Contents are gated behind forum interaction
* No breach vector or field list has been confirmed

None of this has been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If real, a user base of this size is prime material for credential stuffing, booking-themed phishing and identity fraud. Users should change reused passwords and turn on MFA. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Spain #Travel #DataLeak #ThreatIntelligence

🇮🇩 🚨 INDONESIA: 679,000 DOCUMENTS ALLEGEDLY TIED TO THE PRESIDENT'S OFFICE LEAKED

A threat actor using the alias "Sarxeyel" claims on an underground forum to have about 679,000 documents allegedly linked to the Office of the President of Indonesia.

The actor alleges the data includes:
* Official correspondence and letters
* Government documentation and archives

Access is gated behind forum interaction, and no sample has been verified. None of this has been independently confirmed.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If authentic, leaked executive-branch correspondence could expose policy discussions and the personal details of citizens who wrote to the office, and could be used for highly convincing government-themed phishing. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

🇮🇶 🚨 IRAQ: QICARD PAYMENT PROVIDER DATABASE ALLEGEDLY LEAKED

A threat actor using the alias "Jarvutis" has posted a thread on an underground forum claiming to share a leaked database of QiCard (International Smart Card), Iraq's largest electronic payment provider.

What we know so far:
* QiCard runs biometric smart cards used for salary and pension payments to millions of Iraqis
* The download is gated behind forum interaction
* No record count, field list or sample has been shown yet

None of this has been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
If real, data tied to salary and pension cards could fuel identity theft, payment fraud and targeted phishing against government employees and retirees. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

A threat actor on an underground forum is selling what it says are 1,053 unique Venezuelan government email accounts with passwords.

The listing claims:
* 1,053 unique ".gov" email addresses
* user:pass format with no duplicates
* "100% valid" after checks, and "fresh, no reseller history"

Around 96 per cent of the power supply has been restored across eight districts, and 6,400 technical personnel have been mobilised to expedite restoration work. Power supply has been fully restored in Boudh, Malkangiri and Rayagada districts, as well as Berhampur city. More than 99 per cent of power supply has been restored in Nabarangpur, Koraput and Kandhamal. Restoration has reached 98 per cent in Gajapati and 95 per cent in Ganjam. In Ganjam district, which was the worst affected, 34 33-KV feeders and power substations have been restored. Power supply is expected to be fully restored in most places by the end of today. item.description:
🇰🇬 🚨 KYRGYZSTAN: TRAFFIC SAFETY INSPECTORATE DATABASE ALLEGEDLY LEAKED

A threat actor using the alias "Mr_Raccoonn" claims to have leaked a 2026 database tied to Kyrgyzstan's State Traffic Safety Inspectorate, apparently drawn from the compulsory motor insurance (OSAGO) system, and is spreading it via Telegram.

The actor alleges the data includes:
* Full names, dates of birth, home addresses, phone numbers
* Passport details and tax ID numbers (TIN)
* Vehicle data: VIN, license plates, engine specs
* Policy dates, premiums and technical inspection status

Samples were shared as evidence. None of this has been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Passport and tax ID numbers alongside addresses and vehicle records are a strong kit for identity fraud, fake insurance claims and convincing phishing. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

item.description:
RT PIB India
Strengthening India’s Indigenous Navigation Capabilities

▶️The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully accomplished the GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission on 30 October 2026 at 23:51 hours from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC), Sriharikota

▶️The GSLV-F18 launch vehicle injected the Navigation Satellite NVS-03 into a precise Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO). Subsequently, first orbit manoeuvre completed on 31 October 2026 at 16:48 hours. Further manoeuvres are planned to place it in its designated geosynchronous orbital slot at 111.75° East.

▶️The satellite is the third in India's series of five next-generation Navigation satellites and is designed to strengthen the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC), enhancing India's capabilities in satellite-based navigation.

For more details, read: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2331077
